name: The Cove Restaurant & Oyster Bar

evidence.note: Events page lists a DJ on Sat Oct 3, 7:30-11 pm; 23+ for women, 25+ for men; elegant smart attire, no hats.
Summary says live music and DJs create a lively, nightclub-like and noisy atmosphere.
Tourism listing for weekly 'DJ Nights on the Water': come for dinner, stay for the music.

dancing.notes: After dinner a DJ plays on weekend nights, with an age limit and a dress code. Reviews describe a nightclub-like mood, but we could not confirm a dance floor.

description: An upscale waterfront seafood restaurant next to a marina on Glen Cove Creek, with a patio, weekend brunch and DJ nights later in the evening.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's 'DJ - The Cove Glen Cove' matches the venue's own Oct 3 'DJ TBD' listing. Strict age and dress-code rules apply on DJ nights. Some listings add suite '#3427' to the address.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Hours conflict on the site: the footer says closed Mon-Tue, Wed 4-9 PM, Thu 4-10:30 PM, Fri-Sat noon-11 PM, Sun noon-9 PM, while the scrolling banner says 'Open 12 PM daily' and the schema data gives noon opening every day. We used the footer (likely current fall hours). Private-party enquiries go to thecoveny@gmail.com (not recorded as main email). Site says it opened in May 2016 and sits beside Safe Harbor Marina. Dress code applies in the Tiki Bar & Lounge after 8 PM (no hats, athletic wear, sports jerseys, cut-offs or backpacks). Logo is WebP because the image host converted the PNG. Current description is still accurate.
hours: Wed 4 PM-9 PM; Thu 4 PM-10:30 PM; Fri-Sat 12 PM-11 PM; Sun 12 PM-9 PM; closed Mon-Tue (fall hours; DJ Thu-Sun)
